== Biography ==

Tik-tok is a copper man. A yellow hen with fluffy feathers and a pearl necklace is perched on his shoulder when Dorothy runs toward him, calling his name. He lifts the little girl in his copper arms and kisses her cheek with his copper lips, greeting her warmly. The hen, later identified as Billina, treats Tik-tok's shoulder as a place of safety — when the dog Toto threatens her, she flies back to perch there, out of reach.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Dorothy]]''' — friend. Their bond seems close, as the copper man lifted her in his copper arms and kissed her cheek when she ran to greet him.

'''[[Nick Chopper]]''' — friend. The copper man and the tin man are said to have been good friends.

'''[[Billina]]''' — friend. The yellow hen takes refuge on Tik-tok's shoulder when endangered, which could suggest he once saved her life.

'''[[Button-Bright]]''' — friend. A bond between them is suggested, though no direct exchange is recorded in the excerpts.

'''[[Ozma]]''' — employment. An association with Ozma is suggested, hinting at some form of service, though its nature is not detailed.
